bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost the 100-day again
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 再度跌破 100 日均线

read.en: TSMC fell 4.5% on Oct 22 to $412.35, trading between $410.22 and $421.91 on 1.5 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($420.4), 10-day ($429.7), 30-day ($442.9) and 100-day ($430.0) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($397.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($442.47), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 台积电 10月22日下跌 4.5%，收于 $412.35，盘中区间 $410.22–421.91，成交量为平均水平的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$420.4）、10 日（$429.7）、30 日（$442.9）和 100 日均线（$430.0）下方，仍在上行的 200 日均线（$397.1）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$442.47），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The drop gave back the $430 100-day average and the $422.4 5-day, and closed on the $412.5 Sep 15 low. Resistance is $412.5, then $419–421.9 (5-day, Oct 22 high) and $430 (10 and 100-day). Support is $407.1–410.6 (Oct 15, 16 and 22 lows), then $405.2–405.5 and $397.1 (200-day). A close below $405 would open $397; a close above $421.9 would target $430.

s.en: Oct 15 low $407.1; Oct 16 low $410.6; Oct 22 low $410.2
